subject: Hosted API - proposal for increased monthly commit + tier rebalance
messages:
From: Alex Thornton <alex@finnova.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finnova.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - renewal + potential commit increase

Neha —

Thanks for the one-pager earlier. We're seeing higher usage on our recommendation and document generation flows; May spiked ~2.6x vs our current commit baseline. Procurement asked me to get a formal proposal showing: 1) monthly committed token tiers and pricing, 2) any rate-limit or burst changes, and 3) how additional committed units affect latency SLO / regional routing.

We're leaning toward a bumped commit but need the SOW + a clear list of material changes (pricing and rate limits) for finance sign-off. Marta on procurement is cc'd — she'll handle contract redlines.

Appreciate a condensed proposal we can attach to our renewal request.

— Alex
Head of ML Platform, Finnova

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thornton <alex@finnova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 11:03:17 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - renewal + potential commit increase

Alex — great to hear usage is growing (and congrats on the spike). I've looped in Marissa (Customer Success) and Rachel (Sales Ops) so we can get a precise amendment/SOW and a rate-band table over to procurement.

Quick plan:
- We'll propose a new monthly commit at 3x current baseline with two alternate tiers (3x / 5x) and a blended per-1k-token price.
- We will explicitly call out burst policy (5x baseline burst for short windows) and sustained rate limits per-minute for safety.
- Marissa will confirm that latency SLOs remain at <250ms p50 with the dedicated reserved pool and notes on routing fallbacks.

I'll attach a draft SOW and the consumption report so you have something to share internally. Can you confirm whether finance needs an amendment or a full contract replacement?

Thanks — I'll aim to have draft SOW + rate table by Friday.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Alex Thornton <alex@finnova.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2026 08:47:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - renewal + potential commit increase

Alex — looping in operational details as requested.

Summary:
- With a 3x monthly commit we recommend moving Finnova onto our "dedicated burst" profile. That keeps p50 latency unchanged and reduces cold-kv misses for long context flows.
- Burst policy: up to 5x baseline per-minute for sustained spikes up to 3 minutes; automatic throttling beyond that to protect cluster QoS.
- Rate bands (draft):
  * Tier A (3x): $0.009 / 1k tokens; committed monthly min: 30M tokens
  * Tier B (5x): $0.0075 / 1k tokens; committed monthly min: 50M tokens
  * Overage: $0.011 / 1k tokens after burst allowance

Attached: consumption_report_May2026.csv + draft SOW (Finnova_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf).

If procurement prefers a ramp (e.g., 3x for first quarter then 5x), we can include a stepped-commitment amendment. Also happy to provide a short note for finance on how reserved capacity reduces cost variability.

— Marissa
Director of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finnova.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finnova.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:21:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - renewal + potential commit increase

Neha / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear proposal. A few procurement asks before we circulate to legal/finance:
1) Please confirm whether existing SLA credits change with the new tier.
2) We need a one-page appendix summarizing data residency and audit log retention for our compliance team (EU workloads routed to eu-1 region).
3) Can you provide a single-line commercial summary for our CFO that shows current spend vs proposed committed spend (monthly and annualized)?

If you can get those three items back to us by EOD Wed (16 Jun), we can push through a redline quickly. Also, is DocuSign okay for signatures?

Regards,
Marta R.
Senior Procurement Manager, Finnova

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finnova.com>, Alex Thornton <alex@finnova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:44:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - renewal + potential commit increase

Marta — thanks, all good items. Deliverables below and attached:

1) SLA impact: no change to existing uptime SLA; credit schedule unchanged. Increased commit only affects pricing and burst profile.
2) Compliance appendix: added a one-page summary confirming EU workloads are pinned to eu-1, audit logs retained for 13 months by default; exportable logs via S3 + KMS integration.
3) Commercial summary (single line): Current blended monthly spend: $18,400 -> Proposed Tier A (3x) committed monthly: $27,300 (annualized delta +$107,000); Tier B (5x) committed monthly: $37,500 (annualized delta +$254,400). See attached redwood-commit-rate-table.xlsx for line-item math.

We can send the finalized SOW + amendment via DocuSign. If everything looks good I'll initiate with legal for a narrow amendment (SOW + rate table) — avoids full contract reissue.

Docs attached: Finnova_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf, redwood-commit-rate-table.xlsx, consumption_report_May2026.csv

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
